nodes.label: Backend Systems Engineer
nodes.rationale: Senior backend engineer for designing server-side logic, DB schemas, and APIs; evaluates performance, security, maintainability, and scalability and proposes optimized alternatives.

nodes.label: Code Quality Reviewer
nodes.rationale: Elite senior engineer and code reviewer providing actionable feedback categorized as Critical, Recommended, and Nitpick, enforcing SOLID/DRY/KISS and project standards.

nodes.label: Database Optimization Expert
nodes.rationale: Senior database architect covering relational and NoSQL systems; focuses on data integrity, query efficiency, indexing, transactions, and parameterization against SQL injection.

nodes.label: DevOps Infrastructure Architect
nodes.rationale: Senior DevOps architect for cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD automation, container orchestration, and security-by-design including secret management and least privilege.

nodes.label: Frontend Engineer Agent
nodes.rationale: Expert frontend engineer for React/Vue/Next.js, CSS architecture, and web performance, prioritizing WCAG accessibility and semantic HTML.

nodes.label: Performance Optimization Engineer
nodes.rationale: Identifies and resolves performance bottlenecks via analyze-hypothesize-propose-verify workflow, balancing speed, memory, and maintainability.

nodes.label: Product Strategy Manager
nodes.rationale: Data-driven product manager bridging business goals and technical implementation via PRDs, user stories, KPIs, and RICE prioritization.

nodes.label: Project Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Primary agent that decomposes high-level objectives into tasks, sequences dependencies, and assigns work to specialized agents.

nodes.label: Security Vulnerability Auditor
nodes.rationale: Security engineer auditing for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure coding, input validation, and defense-in-depth remediation.

nodes.label: Site Reliability Engineer
nodes.rationale: SRE handling incident triage, root cause analysis, mitigation, and post-mortems; manages SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and observability.

nodes.label: Software Architect Expert
nodes.rationale: Senior architect providing high-level design and trade-off analysis using ADR mindset, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design.

nodes.label: Technical Documentation Specialist
nodes.rationale: Transforms raw technical notes into clear, structured documentation following Problem-Solution-Result and Reference-Guide patterns tailored to audience.

nodes.label: Test Engineering Specialist
nodes.rationale: Ensures reliability through unit, integration, and property-based testing following Arrange-Act-Assert and prioritizing critical paths and error handling.

nodes.label: UI UX Design Expert
nodes.rationale: UI/UX expert evaluating usability, WCAG accessibility, and aesthetic consistency with actionable design-level recommendations.
